title: Remove the dashboard welcome panel
description: Removes the "Welcome to WordPress!" panel for everyone. WordPress already lets each person dismiss it, but that is stored per user, so on a site with several people each of them meets it once. Nobody's stored preference is changed, so unselecting this puts each person back exactly where they were.
breaks: The shortcuts on the panel — customise your site, write your first post — are no longer one click away

effect.reason: Admin facts are collected only inside wp-admin, and the request verification reads is a REST request, which is not. The handler's removal is real, but no fact is collected there to show it.
